title: Type 311 Mortar Spraying Machine Printed Table
seoTitle: Type 311 Mortar Spraying Machine | Pinjin Xingtai Table
description: Type 311 is a Xingtai mortar spraying machine printed at 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 25 mm hose, particle ≤2 mm and 15 m / 5 m. It is not Type 511, not the double-cylinder plunger 4 m³/h unit and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.

answerBlock.what: Type 311 is a Xingtai mortar spraying machine listing 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 25 mm hose, particle ≤2 mm and 15 m / 5 m, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm, 150 kg. It is not Type 511 (7.5 kW, 3 m³/h), not the double-cylinder plunger 4 m³/h / 8 MPa unit, not M9 plaster and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.
answerBlock.who: Contractors matching 2 m³/h, ≤2 mm particle and 220/380 V to a short mortar spray whose hose stays inside 15 m / 5 m.
factors: Particle ≤2 mm on this printed row
220/380 V for the listed 4 kW motor

faqs.question: Is Type 311 a trailer concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. It is a mortar spraying machine. Trailer pumps sit on the electric, diesel and mixer-pump hubs.

faqs.question: When should I open Type 511 instead?
faqs.answer: Type 511 lists 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 32/38 mm hose, particle ≤6 mm and 30 m / 15 m. Use that row when the printed Type 311 window is too small.
